title: Apache superset: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python (CVE-2026-111064)
description: A high-severity security vulnerability (CVE-2026-111064) affects the apache-superset package, related to the AIOHTTP asynchronous HTTP client/server framework used in Python. The vulnerability impacts versions prior to 2021.38.2-r0 and 2021.36.5-r0. A fix is available in these versions.
